chosenApproach: Replace radial transverse collar/cap irradiation with a smoothly rotated unit horizontal normal fan (cos(phi),sin(phi)), phi=local_y*pi/.34. Its normalized vertical response is a z-defined set of broad stone planes and controlled course/roof shoulder transitions; irradiance no longer peaks at cap center y0. Keep strong upward response near the actual roof edge. Native material course integration from accepted04 is retained; native interior planes use geometry rather than a pervasive20% analytic mix, and stronger CORNER face-normal weighting restores useful plane separation. Start with the accepted mesh unchanged; this is an implementation choice, not a new mesh lock. Actual linked graph, normalized field, transforms, full-collar derivatives and same-recipe all4 renders will be audited. Final plane coordinate w=local_z+.10*local_y gently inclines course turns/material across the cap; the actual roof turn stays anchored to local_z. CORNER native normals blend .30 polygon/.70 vertex and remain normalized after interpolation. The native geometry and coherent04 material palette are retained.
